name: Boon
source: Boon is a small visual novel project split into 10 episodes. The main plot is structured around the special relationship between a trans woman and a femboy. This is my first project and I want to keep every episode small and straight to the point. I’m still learning how to make visual novels so please bear with me.
translation: Boon is a small visual novel project split into 10 episodes. The main plot is structured around the special relationship between a trans woman and a femboy. This is my first project and I want to keep every episode small and straight to the point. I’m still learning how to make visual novels so please bear with me.
